title: CustomLookAndFeel (corrected drawPopupMenuItem signature) and RotarySlider
description:
Wave-1 standalone LookAndFeel + rotary control used by later GUI components and the editor.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §9.1 (dark theme, single window), §9.5 (LookAndFeel / drawPopupMenuItem), §13 (Source/GUI layout)
- Peer CustomLookAndFeel / rotary patterns under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/ if present (e.g. AuralMaximizerPro / ShredEQ) for colors and rotary drawing only
- risk_notes: drawPopupMenuItem MUST use the LookAndFeel_V4 individual-parameter signature, NOT PopupMenu::Item&

Implement:
1. Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h/.cpp deriving from juce::LookAndFeel_V4:
   - Dark-theme colour scheme (background, panel, text, accent, outline) suitable for a guitar lead widener UI.
   - Rotary slider drawing (thumb, track, value arc) via drawRotarySlider.
   - Fonts for labels / popup text via getLabelFont / getPopupMenuFont (or equivalent overrides used by the project).
   - Override drawPopupMenuItem with the LookAndFeel_V4 signature:
     void drawPopupMenuItem (Graphics&, const Rectangle<int>& area, bool isSeparator, bool isActive, bool isHighlighted, bool isTicked, bool hasSubMenu, const String& text, const String& shortcutKeyText, const Drawable* icon, const Colour* textColour) override;
     Do NOT implement or call a PopupMenu::Item& overload — it does not exist in the pinned JUCE version.
2. Source/GUI/RotarySlider.h/.cpp factored out of the LookAndFeel:
   - Thin juce::Slider subclass (rotary style, text box below or none as matches peer plugins) that applies CustomLookAndFeel locally or relies on parent LnF.
   - Convenient constructors/setters for labelled rotaries used by Detune/Width/Mix/Trim later; no APVTS attachment ownership here.

Do not implement Goniometer, CorrelationMeter, PluginEditor layout, or CMakeLists.
acceptance_criteria: CustomLookAndFeel derives from juce::LookAndFeel_V4 and implements drawRotarySlider
CustomLookAndFeel::drawPopupMenuItem uses the individual-parameter LookAndFeel_V4 signature (isSeparator, isActive, isHighlighted, isTicked, hasSubMenu, text, shortcutKeyText, icon, textColour)
drawPopupMenuItem does not use a PopupMenu::Item& overload
RotarySlider is a juce::Slider subclass factored for editor rotaries
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: choose dark palette and rotary visual style consistent with peer plugins
optional small shared colour constants in CustomLookAndFeel
forbidden: change pinned JUCE API assumptions for popup menus
